confidence_notes: FX came from the RBA exchange-rate pages found in one search. The RBA figure was dated 2026-11-18 and quoted as USD per AUD. Food and drink anchors are based on one cost-of-living search covering Expatica/Numbeo-style data and GoWira. Cappuccino, beer, and meal prices were supported by that search. Cocktail and wine by the glass had no direct Boston figure. I set them from the local beer price and typical Boston bar and restaurant pricing, with the cocktail at roughly 1.7 times the beer price. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect any listings. Boston hotel prices vary widely by season and event.
comparable_city_reasoning: Boston is a high-cost US Northeast city, comparable to other expensive US coastal cities such as Washington DC and New York at the lower end.
